## Overview

We deepen our data wrangling skills with more advanced dplyr operations — joins, grouped summaries, and chained pipelines. We also look at Simpson's paradox as a cautionary tale about how aggregation can mislead us.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Download

Download the project for this week, unzip it, and double-click `07-content.Rproj` to open it in RStudio: [07-content.zip](/files/projects/07-content.zip)
